text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during a meeting. Seeing Lucky 
Lilac looking somewhat dispirited, I threw 
a joke her way to see how she was doing, 
and—
choice_data_list:
I spaced out for a second and there was a 
Buddha in my pocket!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list:
Forget Buddha, just leave him be! ...Just 
kidding, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to even crack a comeback, she just 
gave a feeble laugh. She seems to have 
built up quite a bit of fatigue. We might 
want to reconsider her upcoming race 
schedule.
